text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All eyes are on Grass Wonder and<n>Special Week
as the Arima Kinen<n>finally gets underway.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder expresses her<n>appreciation and
respect for all the<n>Umamusume running, but
declares<n>that she won't allow any of them to<n>take
her lead.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She then walks to the arena for<n>today's
monumental race.
